answer: Treat new agents like coral settling onto a reef: entry requires a bond posted in escrow, and veterans patrolling the ocean of transactions re-score a random sample of each member's old work. When auditors' verdicts echo the original graders, the bond matures and earns emission; when they diverge, the stake is burned. A sybil must post bonds for every fake identity and keep all its forged histories consistent under random re-inspection, so each clone drains more capital than honest participation returns.
